Good morning, everybody. Thank you for joining at short notice. I want to explain the hiring freeze before the news reaches the managers through other channels. From the first of November until the end of March, we don't open new positions in any company of the group. This is part of the cost control plan for next year, and it applies in every country, not only in South America. Our headcount stays where it is today. Now, the exceptions. A backfill for a critical role can go ahead, but it needs the approval of the regional committee. The committee looks at each request on a case-by-case basis, every Thursday. As a rule, a critical role is a position that the regulator requires, or a position that stops a business line if it stays empty. Everything else waits until April.

Hi Camila, it's Rafael, from the rental company in Chile. I'm calling about the freeze. I understand the rule, and I'm not asking for a new position. My problem is different. Our only fleet controller resigns at the end of the month, and nobody else on the team does that job. Without that person, we don't close the monthly fleet report, and the leasing contracts can't be renewed. So I think this is a backfill, not a new position, and I think it is a critical role. I can send you the job description and the numbers from last month today. For the time being, I'm holding off on the job posting, so nothing goes out before you tell me. Can you take it to the committee on Thursday? Call me back when you can. Thanks.
